definitions.explanation: Relating to or occurring once a year. Used as a prefix or modifier in formal and business contexts.
The number of years one has been in a position, organization, or academic program.

examples.japanese: {年次|ねんじ}{報告書|ほうこくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
{年次|ねんじ}{有給|ゆうきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二十日|はつか}→二十日：02934_hatsuka⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have twenty days of annual paid leave.

examples.japanese: {年次|ねんじ}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The annual convention is scheduled to be held next month.

examples.japanese: {年次|ねんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
{年次|ねんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We evaluate based on ability regardless of seniority.

examples.japanese: {入社|にゅうしゃ}{年次|ねんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met up with colleagues from the same year of hiring after a long time.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in business Japanese, especially in compounds like {年次|ねんじ}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ and {年次|ねんじ}{休暇|きゅうか}. Sense 2 is used in workplace and academic contexts to indicate how many years someone has been at an institution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年次|ねんじ}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (annual report)
- {年次|ねんじ}{有給|ゆうきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか} (annual paid leave)
- {年次|ねんじ}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (annual convention)
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}{年次|ねんじ} (year of hiring)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧: over the course of a year
- ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧: every year (more everyday)
